Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::chooseSupplier(supplierID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		supplier: Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = supplierID),
		obs: Set(OrderProduct) = OrderProduct.allInstance()->select(o|o.oclIsUndefined() = false)
	precondition:
		supplier.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		obs.isEmpty() = bool
	postcondition:
		CurrentOrderProduct.Supplier = supplier and
		result = true
}
